utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re sorting the repair items and tracking the donations, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I’m on it — I’ll sort the repair items and keep track of the donations.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, you’re handling both the sorting and the donations, correct?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — I’m still here and ready to help. Just send me the list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Dane — I’m still sorting it out and I’ll send the list soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll be ready when it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What’s the next thing you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m sorting the list and making sure we have the right materials and drop-off details first. Can you take a look at the porch light and see if it’s just a bulb or something bigger?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can check the porch light and see whether it’s just the bulb or something more. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a hammer and a screwdriver I can bring by for the repair drive. What else do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — those will help a lot. If you can also bring a few extra screws and be here after school pickup, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring a few extra screws and I’ll be there after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What do you need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—what should I bring, and about what time on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, they still need both tools and donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll let folks know they still need both tools and donations, and I’ll pass along that it’s this Saturday on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate you spreading the word. It should help a lot if folks bring tools or donations this Saturday on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We moved it to Sunday at the community center, right? Also, can you check what they still need most?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes — I’m still able to help, and I’ll check what they need most. If I’m remembering right, it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, that’s right—Sunday at the community center. Thanks for checking what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Noah — I’ll let you know when I’m on my way. Appreciate you having the repair items ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Sam — I’ll keep the repair items together and be ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know when I’m headed over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — the repair drive is still set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m finalizing the details now. What can you help with first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I know the next fix for the repair drive. What’s the first thing you want me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — could you start by checking if we have enough tools and volunteers for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for the update — I’ll let everyone know the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive plan once you have the drop-off spot and list of what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll check on the drop-off spot and the list of what to bring, then pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep everyone posted once you send those details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — bring any small broken items you want fixed, and drop them off at the community center’s front lobby. If you’re unsure about anything, I can double-check the details for you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — that’s clear. I’d appreciate it if you could double-check anything that’s still uncertain.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll double-check the repair drive details and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m putting the final details together. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Let’s start by listing the biggest repair needs first, then we can match them with the tools and donations people can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Vik — let’s make a top-priority list of the biggest repair needs and then match each one with the tools and donations people can bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We need help fixing the loose fence at Maple & 3rd and the broken porch light over by Cedar Court. If you can take one of those, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can take the loose fence at Maple & 3rd if that still needs doing. Just want to make sure I’ve got the right spot before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — Maple & 3rd is the right spot for the loose fence. Thanks, Hana; that leaves the porch light at Cedar Court.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still able to help with the repair drive—I’ll keep you posted as soon as I know the next fix they need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Ira — just let me know and I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Gus — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the next repair need. Thanks for bringing the hammer and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still keeping an eye on it, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the next fix they need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just let me know when you hear the next fix, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I know the next repair drive fix they need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, I’m still able to help with the repair drive — what supplies do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We need tools and donations most right now, and it’d help to keep things simple and organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll focus on tools and donations, and keep everything simple and organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’m still in — after school pickup works for me. Let me know what you need me to bring or pass along for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Faye — after school pickup works. If you can bring a few trash bags and help pass along the list, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll bring a few trash bags and pass along the list after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’ll sort the repair items and keep track of the donations, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I can sort the repair items and keep track of the donations.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — that’s confirmed, then?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I’m still a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I’ll let you know if we need anything brought along for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—just let me know what to bring for Sunday, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve heard they’re still short on tools and donations for the repair drive. I can check which one they need most if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be helpful—could you also confirm the drop-off spot and time? I don’t want to send folks to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can check that too and let you know the drop-off spot and time as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — it’s set for Sunday at the community center now. What do they still need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word and see who can bring extra tools or supplies. If you know the biggest gaps, send them my way and I’ll rally folks fast.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still help — what’s left to fix for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — they still need both tools and donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help gather tools and donations. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Sunday at the community center works for me. What items do you need most right now, and I can help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Jules. Right now we need the most help with fixing broken chairs, a leaky faucet, and a couple of flickering lights.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll spread the word that chairs, the faucet, and the lights are the biggest needs. I’ll also check if anyone can bring tools or spare parts on Sunday.
